transcript:
Sam: The budget draft is still missing. I'll send it to Priya by Friday.
Priya: Great. I'll book the venue next Monday.

Marcus: Can someone check the server logs?
Elena: I'll do it today.
Marcus: Perfect, thanks.

Joan: Our slides need a final review.
Tariq: I'll review them by Wednesday.
Joan: Then I'll upload them to the shared drive on Thursday.

Mei: The client wants a revised quote.
Omar: I'll prepare it and send it by end of day.
Mei: I'll call the client tomorrow morning to let them know.

Noah: Who's testing the login fix?
Lena: Me. I'll finish testing by Tuesday.
Noah: Good. I'll deploy it to production on Wednesday.

Grace: We need to order new laptops for the interns.
Raj: I'll get three quotes by the 15th.
Grace: Okay, thanks.

Fatima: The newsletter goes out next week.
Ben: I'll write the intro paragraph by Monday.
Fatima: And I'll collect the photos by Tuesday.

Chris: The printer is jammed again.
Dana: I'll call the repair company this afternoon.
Chris: Thanks.

Isabel: Rent for the studio is due soon.
Kofi: I'll transfer the payment on the 1st.
Isabel: Good. I'll update the budget sheet by Friday.

Hana: Reminder that the survey closes in two weeks.
Victor: I'll send a reminder email next Tuesday.
Hana: Thanks, Victor.

Pedro: The demo environment is down.
Aisha: I'll restart it right now.
Pedro: Thanks. I'll message the sales team by 3 pm.

Yuki: Can we get the contract signed?
Leo: I'll send it to legal today.
Yuki: And I'll follow up with them on Friday.

Lee: Nice work everyone. That's all for this week.
Ana: Thanks, see you all.

Paul: The quarterly numbers look strong.
Sara: Yes, revenue is up eight percent.
Paul: Great news. Let's celebrate.

Rita: How was the conference?
Omar: Really useful. The keynote was great.
Rita: Glad to hear it.

Tom: Did anyone finish the report?
Nina: I sent it yesterday.
Tom: Right, I got it. Looks good.

Ivy: We could maybe redesign the homepage at some point.
Jon: Maybe. No plans yet though.
Ivy: Fair enough.

Zoe: The team lunch is at noon.
Arjun: Perfect, see you there.
Zoe: Don't be late!

Carla: The onboarding guide has outdated screenshots.
Dev: I'll update them.
Carla: Thanks.

Mia: Someone should email the vendor about the delay.
Hugo: I'll take care of it.
Mia: Great.

Ethan: We still have to fix the mobile layout bug.
Priti: I'll look into it.
Ethan: And I'll review your fix when it's ready.

Wes: The meeting notes need to go out.
Sofia: I'll send them.
Wes: Thanks.

Dmitri: Our backup script hasn't been tested.
Alma: I'll test it.
Dmitri: Good.

Kim: The supplier list needs cleaning up.
Jabu: I'll handle it.
Kim: Appreciated.

Alex: Three things. First, Bianca will finalize the logo by Thursday.
Bianca: Yes, I'll do that.
Alex: Second, Chen will print the flyers on Friday.
Chen: Sounds good.
Alex: Third, I'll book the room today.

Rosa: Let's divide the work. I'll write the introduction by Monday.
Tobi: I'll handle the data analysis by Wednesday.
Lucy: I'll do the references and formatting by Friday.

Greg: Matteo, can you fix the broken link on the pricing page?
Matteo: Sure, I'll do it this morning.
Greg: And Hye, can you update the FAQ?
Hye: Yes, by tomorrow.

Olga: The event is in ten days. Jamal will confirm the caterer by Tuesday.
Jamal: Right.
Olga: Nia will send out the invitations by Wednesday.
Nia: Noted.

Felix: I'll draft the proposal by Thursday and Anya will review it by Friday.
Anya: That works for me.

Beth: Release checklist: Omar updates the changelog on Monday, Li runs the final tests on Tuesday, and I'll publish on Wednesday.
Omar: Got it.
Li: Got it.

Ana: Pablo will send the invoice by Friday.
Pablo: Actually I'm out Friday. Can Ruth do it?
Ruth: Sure, I'll send the invoice on Friday.

Jin: I'll finish the prototype by Monday.
Mara: The client moved the demo, so Wednesday works too.
Jin: Then I'll aim for Wednesday.

Nora: Can you cover the Saturday shift?
Ibrahim: Sorry, I can't.
Nora: No problem, I'll ask Kelly myself tomorrow.

Sven: I already sent the contract to the client yesterday.
Lila: Great. They'll probably have questions, so I'll schedule a call for Thursday.

Ron: If the budget gets approved, we might hire another designer.
Tess: Maybe. Let's wait and see.
Ron: Agreed.

Uma: We all need to complete the safety training this month.
Kai: Yes, definitely.
Uma: Okay, that's the reminder.

Hector: Dana from finance will approve the expense report by Friday.
Sasha: Great, thanks for letting me know.

Elif: Could someone maybe look at the failing tests?
Rob: Hmm, I'm swamped this week.
Elif: No worries, I'll look at them on Monday.
Quinn: I'll send the agenda on Tuesday and the minutes on Friday.

Dara: I was going to write the blog post by Friday.
Eli: Marketing cancelled it, so no need.
Dara: Okay, I'll skip it.

Monica: Morning all. Quick status check on the mobile app project.
Dennis: Testing is mostly done. Two bugs remain, both on Android.
Monica: Can you fix them before the release?
Dennis: Yes, I'll fix both by Thursday.
Priya: Marketing wants screenshots for the store page.
Monica: Priya, can you take those?
Priya: Sure. I'll capture them next Tuesday.
Monica: Great. I'll write the release notes by Wednesday. That's it, thanks.

Hal: We decided to move the launch to March, right?
Gina: Yes, March 3rd.
Hal: Then someone has to tell the partners.
Gina: I'll email them by Monday.
Hal: And the pricing stays the same. No changes needed.
Gina: Correct.

Carmen: Let's review last month's support metrics.
Yusuf: Response time improved to under two hours.
Carmen: And customer satisfaction?
Yusuf: 92 percent, up from 89.
Carmen: That's solid. The team did well.
Yusuf: Agreed. Nothing needs changing right now.

Ingrid: Let's plan the offsite.
Bao: I checked three venues last week. The lakeside one is best.
Ingrid: Good. Bao, please book it by the 20th.
Bao: Will do.
Ingrid: Cole, can you arrange the transportation?
Cole: Yes, I'll have a bus quote by next Friday.
Ingrid: Faith, we need a schedule of activities.
Faith: I'll draft it this week.
Ingrid: And I'll announce the date to the whole company on Monday.

Tyler: Heads up, the fridge in the break room smells awful.
Wanda: Ugh. I'll clean it out after lunch.
Tyler: Hero. I'll buy new filters for the coffee machine on my way in tomorrow.
